name: Coordinator Claude
description: Engineering management layer for Claude Code --- structures your session like a real dev team where you're PM and Claude is EM. Provides session workflows, multi-persona code review (staff engineer, UX, front-end, data science reviewers), structured planning, agent delegation, handoffs between sessions, and daily routines. You set direction; Claude makes engineering calls and runs them by you.
longDescription:
Ships **26 skills**, **16 agents**, **11 commands** and **4 hooks**.

- **Skills** (26): `architecture-rotation` (Run the weekly architecture audit rotation — score systems, audit the highest-priority target, apply findings, and update the…), `brainstorming` (Use for new feature requests, vague/ambiguous requirements, or multi-subsystem decomposition before plan mode), `bug-sweep` (Systematic codebase bug hunt — find and fix all AI-fixable bugs in-session, defer blocked ones to backlog), `code-health` (Night-shift code health review — queries today's completion entries for touched surfaces, dispatches a reviewer, applies findings, and…), `consolidate-git` (Cleans up branch sprawl), `debt-triage` (EM-PM conversation to review and prioritize the technical debt backlog), `dogfood` (Smoke-driven fix-through loop — invoke a newly-built thing (skill, script, pipeline, install process) and fix bugs until it…), `enrich-and-review` (Run enrichment pipeline on chunk directories), and 18 more
- **Agents** (16): `code-reviewer` (Sonnet code reviewer with obsessive standards — flags nitpicks, weak tests, dead code, unclear naming, dubious abstractions, missing…), `dep-cve-auditor` (Sonnet worker agent for dependency CVE auditing), `doc-link-checker` (Sonnet worker agent for documentation link validation), `docs-checker` (Use this agent to verify API references in artifacts (plans, code, stubs) against authoritative documentation before dispatching expensive…), `eng-director` (the Director of Engineering — Director of Engineering), `enricher` (Use this agent when plan stub documents need enrichment with research findings), `executor` (Use this agent when enriched and reviewed stub specifications are ready for implementation), `external-pattern-checker` (Opt-in pre-flight that does bounded web research (≤5 WebFetch, ≤2 WebSearch, ≤6 topics) on architecturally-loaded plan claims that…), and 8 more
- **Commands** (11): `architecture-audit` (Bootstrap or refresh the architecture atlas via multi-phase agent pipeline (Haiku scouts → Sonnet analysts → Opus synthesizer)), `autonomous` (Toggle autonomous execution mode — suppresses /handoff nudges from the context pressure hook when the PM wants the…), `bug-blitz` (Autonomously grind tasks/bug-backlog.md — verify each item still applies, fix small items in parallel waves, surface big ones…), `distill` (Distill session artifacts into evergreen wiki + decisions; trim + archive canonical specs; delete scaffolding), `mise-en-place` (Autonomous backlog execution — gathers ready items, builds compaction-proof flight recorder, runs sequentially), `setup` (Set up the coordinator plugin — check prerequisites, verify environment, configure project), `update-docs` (Repo-wide documentation maintenance and sync), `workday-complete` (End-of-day orchestration — validate, consolidate branches, daily review, append to week-changelog), and 3 more
- **Hooks** (4): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreCompact`

Installs with `claude plugin install coordinator-claude@claude-community` from `oduffy-delphi/coordinator-claude` (`plugins/coordinator`).
